{{Quote|Be sure there are none besides the Nagai, and our allies and prisoners, alive anywhere on this world.|Cyn Jodu|<ref name="marvel97" />}}
'''Cyn Jodu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Nagai expeditionary force]]. Alongside her superior officer, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dal Zorfenn]], Jodu was tasked with securing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]] that it might serve as the primary base of operations for the Nagai fleet's planned [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="nagai">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cyn Jodu first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 97|''Star Wars'' (1977) 97]], released in [[1985]].<ref name="marvel97" /> Although initially unnamed in her first appearance, the character received the name "Cyn Jodu" in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article ''[[The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs]]''<ref name="nagai" />&mdash;Jodu was named after [[Cynthia Martin]] and [[Mary Jo Duffy]], the penciller and writer, respectively, of Jodu's original comic appearance.<ref name="jmm">{{WebCite|url=http://www.myuselessknowledge.com/swfa/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=95|text=Endnotes for The Forgotten War -- Addendum|archivedate=20170820110424}}</ref>
